name: Grid Active Power
remarks: CBE: positive = feed-in, negative = import; Lyra / Atlas: positive = import, negative = feed-in

name: PV Total Input Power
remarks: Sum of all PV channel inputs

name: PV Curtailment Switch
remarks: `0` = off (charge / grid-tie priority), `1` = on (limit PV input)

name: Target Charge/Discharge Power
remarks: Used with register 10105; sets the actual power setpoint

name: Charge/Discharge Cutoff SOC
remarks: Charge upper limit or discharge lower limit; 10–100
